change_summary: Observed-only repaired PEAD bucket attribution. Reads the exp-20260527-908 enriched watchlist and compares primary-positive EPS revision rows across inside-T+2..T+15 non-overextended, inside-T+2..T+15 residual-leader, outside-PEAD, and still-missing last_earnings_date buckets.

gate1.note: Observed-only attribution; no before/after core strategy metrics change.

source_gate2.name: required_input_fields_present
source_gate2.note: ticker + as_of_date are always present in the source artifact (verified by exp-20260525-034 schema).

gate4.note: Observed-only result can only unlock a later default-off Gate 1-4 strategy experiment.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: Repaired PEAD T+2..T+15 primary positive revision rows that are not residual leaders are a better continuation bucket than residual-leader PEAD rows or primary positives outside PEAD.
gate_questions.2_history_check: exp-20260527-005/006/007 were blocked by missing last_earnings_date; exp-20260527-908 repaired the PIT field and showed 8 non-residual and 7 residual primary-positive inside-PEAD rows.
gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Observed-only pass requires sufficient closed 5d/10d outcomes, non-overextended inside-PEAD to beat residual-leader and outside-PEAD comparators on avg return and PnL, and concentration below guardrails.

hypothesis: After the PIT last_earnings_date repair, primary positive EPS revision rows that are inside the T+2..T+15 PEAD window and not residual leaders should outperform residual-leader PEAD rows and primary-positive rows outside the PEAD window.

nearby_prior_experiments.finding: Initial PEAD comparison was blocked because primary positive rows were missing last_earnings_date.
Short-horizon PEAD probe needed repaired earnings-date coverage and 2d outcome persistence.
Related PEAD continuation probe closed observed_only_data_gap before the PIT join.
Measurement repair resolved last_earnings_date for 40/47 primary positive rows and created inside/outside PEAD buckets.

next_evidence_needed: Persist more 10d closed outcomes for the repaired PEAD buckets, especially non-overextended inside-PEAD and outside-PEAD primary positive rows. Do not promote a PEAD rule until 10d comparison coverage clears the minimum and the edge remains directionally positive.

parameters.non_overextended_definition: not residual_leader and residual_state not in residual_leader/strong_residual_leader
